Run the three directly affected suites explicitly

Run the repository's full gate set (verify-deploy.sh, no --skip-slow) once over the integrated change set and attribute every finding
State explicitly that .claude/ is not regenerated by this task

approaches_tried.approach: Run verify-deploy.sh (no --skip-slow) via Bash run_in_background + a separate kill-0 wait loop, across two tool-call turns
approaches_tried.reason: Both the backgrounding call and the wait loop returned completion notifications whose tail-N snapshot raced the writer -- the first wait's tail -60 captured the log mid-write, stopping at gate 7, producing a false appearance of an unresolved/stalled run even though the underlying process (confirmed via a later direct `cat` of the log file and `ps aux`) had actually finished and exited 0 by the time it was re-checked. The team lead's nudge flagged this as a stall. Resolution: re-ran the full command in the FOREGROUND via the Bash tool's own `timeout` parameter (up to 480000ms) instead of backgrounding -- this is what gate 8 (tests/run-all.sh) needed, and it completed in well under that bound.

approaches_tried.approach: Run gate 8 (tests/run-all.sh) foreground via Bash tool timeout=480000ms, no shell-level `timeout` wrapper
approaches_tried.reason: Completed in ~2-3 minutes with full, non-truncated output -- the shell-level `timeout 115 ... | tail -60` wrapper used in the first (failed) attempt was itself the bug: it raced the pipeline and SIGTERM'd the whole chain at 115s regardless of the Bash tool's own longer budget.

deploy_state_note: The deployed .claude/ tree is NOT updated by this task. All five edited files live only in the source store (agent-system/extensions/core/). .claude/** is a disposable deploy artifact; regeneration (<leader>al 'Reload All', or deploy-headless.sh) is an operator action deliberately left outside this change. Until that regeneration happens, the repaired lifecycle hook mechanism is live in the source store only -- the resolver/hook probes in this and every prior phase's progress file were run by sourcing the SOURCE-STORE copy directly (never the deployed .claude/scripts/skill-base.sh), which is why they already demonstrate the fix despite no deploy having occurred.
